evals.prompt: We just copied launchpad last week for our team. Can you pull in the latest upstream changes? We haven't set up any upstream remote yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect no upstream remote, ask for the upstream URL, add it, fetch latest, show what changed, protect teams/*.yml and CLAUDE.md, and merge cleanly.

assertions.name: checks_clean_working_tree
assertions.description: Runs git status --porcelain to verify clean working tree before proceeding

assertions.name: asks_for_upstream_url
assertions.description: Asks the user for the upstream repo URL if no remote is set

assertions.name: shows_changes_before_sync
assertions.description: Shows what would change before copying files

assertions.name: asks_confirmation
assertions.description: Uses AskUserQuestion to confirm before proceeding

assertions.name: uses_file_copy_strategy
assertions.description: Uses git checkout upstream/main -- <file> rather than git merge

assertions.name: protects_team_files
assertions.description: Preserves teams/*.yml and CLAUDE.md during sync

evals.prompt: Is my launchpad up to date with the main repo?
evals.expected_output: The skill should check upstream, fetch latest, and report whether the repo is up to date.

assertions.name: compares_commits
assertions.description: Checks for new commits in upstream

assertions.name: reports_status
assertions.description: Tells the user whether they are up to date or what changes are available

evals.prompt: Sync with upstream — I've been modifying some of the skill files locally and I know there might be conflicts.
evals.expected_output: The skill handles the sync, preserves protected files, and interactively reviews reviewable files.

assertions.name: checks_clean_working_tree
assertions.description: Verifies working tree is clean before proceeding

assertions.name: identifies_protected_files
assertions.description: Identifies teams/*.yml and CLAUDE.md as protected

assertions.name: uses_file_copy_strategy
assertions.description: Uses git checkout upstream/main -- <file> rather than git merge

assertions.name: reviews_claude_md
assertions.description: Shows diff for CLAUDE.md and asks user what to do
